deploy-bot: preflight heartbeat started for rollout v2026.03.15-rc2 — running SLO gates (p95 latency, 5xx rate, kv-cache 429s). follow here: https://grafana.redwood.local/d/ops/slo-overview

maria: thanks — can we get a short list of the exact thresholds the bot is enforcing? i want to flag before the window if anything looks tight

josh: current gate thresholds (from the deploy config):
- p95 latency (api): 300ms
- 5xx rate (5m window): 0.5%
- kv-cache 429s (rate): >0.1% triggers hold
- error-budget burn: >50% in 1h = pause

josh: quick PromQL we use for the 5xx check:
```
(sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="api",status=~"5.."}[5m]))
/ sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="api"}[5m]))) > 0.005
```

maria: ok good, watching the dashboard. can we also bubble up per-region p95s? last deploy had eu-west p95 spikes that were masked by global metrics

josh: deploy-bot is emitting zone-level heartbeats too — see panel dropdown. but manual check: eu-west p95 = 420ms (5m), us-east p95 = 190ms

elaine: noted. if eu-west stays >350ms for two consecutive heartbeats, we'll pin the route to model-variant v2026.03.14 (previous) for eu-west only and continue. that's our documented rollback-lite plan :clipboard:

sre-oncall: quick sanity run from the preflight job (results at 1765004350):
- api p95: 215ms
- api 5xx: 0.12%
- kv-cache 429: 0.02%
- embed route 5xx: 0.08%
all green atm but eu-west p95 creeping — keep eyes on it

maria: thanks. if we see 5xx above 0.5% during the first 10m of canary, preference is immediate pause + rollback, not gradual pin (we have no margin there)

josh: agreed. adding an explicit instruction to the deploy runbook: `if 5xx>0.5% in any zone in first 10m -> pause & rollback to last-stable`

deploy-bot: heartbeat @1765004365: canary traffic shifted 8% -> 20% (staged), telemetry snapshot attached: p95=225ms, 5xx=0.14%

maria: thumbs on dashboards. everyone set to call pause if we hit those thresholds. i'll be in the release room for the next 30m :phone:

elaine: i'll prepare the pin command just in case: `./deployctl pin --route=eu-west --version=v2026.03.14 --reason="preflight eu-west p95"`

sre-oncall: heads up — i've got an outage pager watch on if 5xx >1% for more than 2m. otherwise i'll chime in on the thread

josh: perfect. if we need to abort, deploy-bot can auto-rollback once an approver posts `rollback now` in this thread (configured), otherwise manual pin is our intermediate measure

maria: ok proceeding. call out any spikes in this thread, and annotate the grafana panel with the heartbeat id: hb-1765004365

deploy-bot: heartbeat @1765004387: canary p95=238ms, 5xx=0.11%, eu-west p95=398ms (down from 420). continuing to monitor. next heartbeat in 60s.
